sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No candidate is verified because the supplied terms do not represent calculation-input evidence, flange-fitted branch selection, or material inclusion/exclusion semantics.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: The graph only checks co-occurrence: a ship-level result can be satisfied by any structural member having web and attached-shell thicknesses, without proving that those net values were used for that result. It also lets a fitted flange pass with no net flange thickness or branch-selection evidence and omits the shear-area rule allowing full-depth web/flange material while excluding attached shell plating.
